audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven level-chart rows are inverted against their own why text. whys[0] says Pantheon 'genuinely owns the lane's opening' but win[0] is Gnar; whys[1] says 'you own level 2' but win[1] is Skill; whys[2] says 'he can't reach you' but win[2] is Pantheon; whys[3] calls it a volatile window but win[3] is Pantheon; whys[5] and whys[6] both say you outscale him, but win[5] and win[6] are Pantheon.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Pantheon, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Gnar, Gnar, Gnar], matches every why line, and matches the 53.22% win rate. The stored chart was reading as a losing lane on a page whose prose says the opposite.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with ratings realigned (level 1 down to 4/10 for Pantheon, Gnar rows 6-7/10, level 4-5 to 5/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phases carried template text about a Stridebreaker spike and gave no cooldowns for the one ability the whole page tells you to track.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s. Knowing it is thirteen seconds at rank 1 is what turns 'trade on his W cooldown' into something you can count.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].why rewritten to the real story, with Shield Vault's 13s stated at level 3 and the 1100-vs-575 range gap stated in dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault (E) is never mentioned anywhere in this matchup, and it is the ability that decides whether a Mega commit connects. Riot's text: he sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the FRONT, and strikes repeatedly. It is a channel, so CC cancels it, and it runs 22s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his kit. Separately, Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset, so his burst opens on an auto wind-up rather than a visible cast.
audit.why: All three are flagged in _missing for this exact pairing and all three are readable in Riot's own text. Dumping a Mega combo into a fresh Aegis Assault from the front is the single most common way this lane is thrown.
audit.corrected: The front-only block and Wallop cancelling the channel stated in dontsFull[1].d; the auto-reset tell stated in dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].t reads 'Sit low for his W execute'. Pantheon's W is Shield Vault, a dash that damages and stuns — there is no execute anywhere in his kit text.
audit.why: A player reading that will hold health thresholds against an ability that does not exist while ignoring the front-block that actually beats their combo.
audit.corrected: The description under it is fixed here; the title itself is 25 characters and sits on the applier's length floor, so it needs a manual pass. report[11].t repeats the same phrase verbatim.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Pantheon contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His thrown Comet Spear out-pokes your fragile Mini and his W stun-dash lets him stick — he owns the lane's opening.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Pantheon's Shield Vault is down.
edits.after: Your level-2 Hyper third-hit plus a Boomerang is a free ranged chunk his Q cannot trade back — take the shove.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Pantheon must walk into your range.
edits.after: Shield Vault is his only gap-close and it runs 13s at rank 1 — hold Mini range and he simply cannot reach you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shield Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Volatile: with Mega banked a Wallop stun wins, but with Rage down his W-stun all-in punishes squishy Mini — track your transform.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: He only gains a global R at 6 while you gain the wall-combo — with Mega up you flip him into terrain for the kill.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shield Vault's cooldown.
edits.after: Your Mini poke keeps chipping while his early burst falls off a cliff once items land.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Pantheon carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A spent early bully once items land — your kiting and wall-GNAR! outscale him, so just respect his global R roams.

edits.before: Boomerang Pantheon's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Boomerang reaches 1100 and Comet Spear only 575 — last-hit from that gap and he cannot answer a point of it.

edits.before: Pantheon wastes Shield Vault (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Shield Vault is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks only the front; Wallop's stun cancels it.

notes: Restating the mirror's findings from this side rather than re-deriving them: GNAR! is a displacement that stuns only on terrain contact, and the Mega CC he must respect on cooldown is Wallop at 7s. Both are consistent with what this page already says, so no contradiction to fix. One thing I could not settle and did not write: Aegis Assault is flagged both 'shield' and 'untargetable' in the kit, but Riot's text says only that he is invulnerable to damage from the front — whether GNAR!'s displacement still moves him during it is not answerable from the file, so the page says nothing about it. Also flagging that diff reads TRICKY at 7.5/10 on a 53.22% lane whose chart now gives Gnar five of seven rows; the rating may want revisiting, but that is a judgement call above a matchup audit.
